crime_highlights: He grabbed Mr. Leo from behind and threw him to the ground.
Mr. Peters started to punch him and repeatedly stomped on Mr. Leo's head, smashing it into the ground.
He kicked Mr. Leo in the head until he could no longer get up.
Death was caused by trauma to the head.
Mr. Peters left the scene but returned the next morning and found Mr. Leo to be breathing.
rationale_highlights: the judge noted the message from the Supreme Court of Canada in Gladue
he was taking into account the principles of deterrence, the principles of aboriginal sentencing, and all of the subjective elements argued before him
note: Appeal court only says judge took aboriginal sentencing principles into account.
